text: Kyoto Financial Group, Inc. (TSE Prime code 5844) lists its major shareholders as of 31 March 2026 as The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (trust account, 12.37%), Nippon Life Insurance Company (3.84%), State Street Bank and Trust Company 505001 (3.54%), Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Company (3.52%), Custody Bank of Japan, Ltd. (trust account, 3.12%), Northern Trust Co. (2.57%), Kyocera Corporation (2.24%), Sumitomo Life Insurance Company (1.85%) and the group's employee stock-ownership association (1.79%).
short: Kyoto Financial Group is Tokyo-listed; its largest holder is Master Trust at 12.37%.
